lineMethod: Count nonempty noncomment lines in six new production/tool files and four new test files. Diff the two existing UI files against the immediately preceding preserved R76 app source. The pre-R77 copy of the canonical-scene browser tool is not preserved, so its changes are excluded from every line threshold. Generated manifests, receipts, screenshots, documents, lockfiles, and concurrent physics changes are excluded.
behavior: Mobile web review uses a list/detail flow with back, previous, and next navigation for all 96 A and Beta entry rows and nine held readiness rows.
A frozen 96-row, 36-scene, 49-asset candidate matrix cross-checks 20 prior raw source pins and immutable V616 snapshot/projection digests.
Offline replay rejects missing, forged, promoted, or byte-drifted records and rechecks 57 file pins.
Local HTTP checks distinguish enabled candidate preview from default-off denial for 19 review images and five policy-held routes.
Browser checks traverse every review row and canonical A-line scene on desktop and simulated mobile, with screenshot byte and dimension replay.
